description: Files classified STANDARD_SAFE by H1A static analysis but that FAIL when run with zero Supabase/AI/payment credentials, discovered by Phase H1S-FIX's secret-free proof run. Root cause: lib/repositories/assessment.repository.ts line ~1400 (a top-level 'export const assessmentRepository = new AssessmentRepository()') eagerly constructs a real Supabase client via BaseRepository's constructor at MODULE IMPORT TIME, not on first use. Any file that imports the shared repos singleton (lib/repositories/index.ts) or assessment.repository.ts directly — even if its own test logic is pure/mocked — throws 'Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY' unless those PRODUCTION-named variables happen to be set. These files previously appeared to pass only because npm test always loaded .env.local (real production credentials) before this phase. They are NOT fixed by npm run test:deep either — DEEP intentionally sets only TEST_SUPABASE_*, not the production-named variables this code path reads, so the same construction would still throw there too. Fixing this requires a production-code change (lazy repository construction, or constructor-injectable clients) that is out of scope for H1S-FIX. Excluded from both scripts/standard-tests.json and scripts/deep-tests.json until that remediation happens — tracked here so they are not silently lost.
